info.cls_ename: FCU Pre-major Program for International Freshman Students

description.describe_ch: 建立興趣選項課程，探索與培養學生的運動興趣，幫助學生瞭解各項運動相關歷史文化、規則，運動與營養補給的重要性，運動傷害的預防及復健，運動訓練處方的建構，期能經由團體運動模式，使學生學習互助合作，強化學生群育發展。
description.describe_eh: By offering students a variety of optional courses, we can motivate students to explore themselves and make exercise a habit. In addition, students get to know the histories, cultures, and rules of different sports; to know the importance of exercise and nutrition supplements, prevention and rehabilitation of sports injuries, and structures of sports training. Hopefully, via team sports, we can help students learn to cooperate with one another and strengthen their development of group education.

targets.describe_ch: 拓展運動學習領域，養成終身運動的習慣，進而提高整體生活品質。
targets.describe_en: To expand the field of sports learning, make lifelong exercising a habit, and enhance students’ overall life quality.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: 體適能測驗成績。依體適能系統給分，兩項在全校大一後10%，需完成「體適能諮商輔導」及「補救教學3次」，未完成者本項0分。

Soccer Skill Tests (20 pt): Passing (15) + Shooting (5)
Darts Skill Tests (20 pt): Darts Contest (include movement assessment)

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
期中 (20分)：體適能測驗成績。
依體適能系統給分，兩項在全校大一後10%，需完成「體適能諮商輔導」及「補救教學3次」，未完成者本項0分。
 
期末 (40分)：
  1. 足球技能測驗 (20分)：傳接球 (15分)+射門(5分)
  2. 飛鏢技能 (20分)：分組對抗賽 (含動作檢驗)。
 
平時 (40分)：平時成績為下列項目之加總
  1. 出席與課堂表現(35分)：依班級整體表現、個人表現及態度
  2. 遲到 -0.5~2。
      事病假-2~10分每多一次多扣一分。
      曠課扣1/3平時成績。
      不告而別平時成績0分。
  3. 「總缺席6次」、「曠課3次」、「不告而別」、「代簽到」平時成績0分直接當掉，不接受加分。
  4. 運動參與加分 (0~20分)
 
運動參與加分 (最高+20)
  1. 規律運動。(參考 ilearn 資料)
  2. 運動會參加比賽：+7 (平時+5，考試+2，總計最多+10)。
  3. 運動會器材組志工：+5。
  3. 其他賽事視狀況給分。
  4. 曠課、不告而別之扣分不可用加分項加回。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Midterm (20 points): Based on the physical fitness grading system, students who score in the bottom 10% of two categories among all freshmen must complete “physical fitness counseling” and “three remedial sessions.” Failure to attend without a valid reason will result in a score of zero for this section.
 
Final (40 points):
  1. Soccer Skill Tests (20 pt): Passing (15) + Shooting (5)
  2. Darts Skill Tests (20 pt): Darts Contest (include movement assessment)
 
Regular Performance (40 points) (Total of the following items):
  1. Attendance and Classroom Performance (35 pt): Points based on overall class and individual performance
  2. Late: -0.5 to -2 points;
    LEAVE OF ABSENCE for illness or personal reasons: -2 to -10 points, with one additional point deducted for each additional absence. 
    SKIP (unexcused absences) deduct 1/3 of the regular performance score;
    LEAVING WITHOUT PERMISSION: 0 points for regular performance.
  3. “Six total absences,” “three unexcused absences,”  “leaving without permission," or "Proxy sign-in" will result in a regular performance score of 0 points, no bonus points accepted, and fail the cours.
  4. Sports & exercise participation (0 ~ 20 points)
 
Bonus for sports & exercise participation (maximum +20 points):
  1. Regular exercise records (refer to ilearn materials).
  2. Sports Day competition: +7 points (Participation +5, Exam +2, Max total +10)
  3. Equipment crew volunteer: +5 points
  4. Other events: points given depending on circumstances
  5. Deductions for unexcused absences or leaving without permission cannot be recovered with bonus points
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
本課程強烈要求「運動員精神」：追求卓越表現、公平競爭、遵守規定，誠實、尊重、負責、團隊合作、堅持。
1. 運動服，運動鞋，服裝不合規視同缺席扣分 。
    禁：牛仔褲、工作褲、卡其褲、西裝褲、拖鞋、皮鞋、皮靴。
    飛鏢課可：卡其褲、西裝褲、皮鞋、皮靴。
2. 上課未依規定使用手機，經勸不聽者，視同缺席。
3. 出缺席：
 (1) 每週上課都會點名或簽到，上課時應盡力參與課堂活動。若身體不適，應主動告知老師。
 (2) 遲到：超過10分鐘才到即計遲到，遲到30分鐘以上該週計缺席。
 (3) 缺席：
    (3.1) 請假：缺席時以學校系統請假，並依學校規定時程處理。
                       事病假證明只需親自手寫原因並拍照上傳。
                       喪假不扣分，需附證明，並在請假後另通知老師避免被列為事假。
    (3.2) 曠課：缺席但未完成請假計為曠課，每次扣1/3平時成績。
    (3.3) 總缺席6次、曠課3次，本學期平時成績0分，學期成績不通過。
 (4) 早退：務必先告知老師再離開。
                 簽到或點名後，未告知老師而早退者，或找他人代簽到/點名者，經第二次點名確認後，視同欺騙行為，本學期平時成績0分且學期成績不通過。
4. 常上iLearn並隨時注意iLearn公告，上課資料也會放在ilearn，並注意學校email的通知信。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
This course strongly emphasizes “sportsmanship”: Pursuit of excellence, fair competition, follow rules, honesty, respect, responsibility, teamwork, and perseverance.

1. Proper sportswear and sports shoes are required. Non-compliant attire will be treated as an absence and result in a point deduction. 
    Prohibited: Jeans, cargo pants, dress pants, chino pants, sandals, dress shoes, and boots.
    Allowed in the darts class: Chino pants and dress pants (trousers), dress shoes, and boots

2. Using a mobile phone in class without permission, and ignoring warnings, will be considered an absence.

3. Attendance & absence:
  (1) Attendance will be taken or signed in every week. Participate in class activities to the best of your ability. If you feel unwell, inform the instructor.
  (2) Late: Arriving more than 10 minutes late. More than 30 minutes late counts as absent for that week.
  (3) Absence:
       (3.1) Leave of Absences: must be reported through the school system and follow official procedures. In this course, personal and sick leave only requires a handwritten with a photo upload. Bereavement leave does not incur deductions but requires proof and notifying the instructor to avoid being marked as personal leave
       (3.2) SKIP (unexcused absence): Absences without a leave request. Each skip will result in a deduction of 1/3 of the regular performance score (-13 pt).
       (3.3) “Six total absences,” or “three unexcused absences.” Semester attendance score: 0. Semester grade: Fail.
  (4) Leaving early: You must inform the instructor before leaving. If a student signs in or answers roll call but leaves early without informing the Teacher, or have someone else sign in/answer roll for him/her, and this is confirmed during a second roll call, it will be considered as cheating. As a result, the student’s attendances score for the semester will be calculated as 0. Semester grade: Fail.

4. Check iLearn regularly and pay attention to announcements. Class materials will also be posted on iLearn. Please also check your school email for notifications.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1. 第5週適逢運動會週，請配合協助運動會場地整理與佈置
2. 轉適應體育班：加退選期間持「醫院證明」至體育教學中心辦理。 
3. 對運動和學習展現熱忱，積極參與活動，有助輕鬆通過！
4. 本課程為全實體上課，未開放線上課程
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Week 5 coincides with FCU Sports Days; please assist with venue setup and organization.
2. To transfer to the Adaptive PE class: bring a “medical certificate” to the PE Office during the add/drop period.
3. Show enthusiasm for sports and learning, and actively participate in activities to help pass the course easily.
4. This course is fully in-person; online classes are not available.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. 簽到或點名後，未告知老師而早退者，或找他人代簽到/點名者，經第二次點名確認後，視同欺騙行為，平時成績0分計算。
2. 書面報告、作業若有抄襲情事，本課程不通過，並送校規處理。
3. 考試找他人代考者，本課程不通過，並送校規處理。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Students who leave early without notifying the teacher after signing in or being called, or those who have someone else sign in or answer roll call for them, will be considered as committing cheating behavior upon second verification. Their regular performance score will be recorded as zero.
     
  2. Written reports and assignments found to be plagiarized will result in failing the course and will be handled according to school policy.
     
  3. Having someone else take an exam will result in failing the course and will be handled according to school policy.

1. 運動服，運動鞋，服裝不合規視同缺席扣分 。
    禁：牛仔褲、工作褲、卡其褲、西裝褲、拖鞋、皮鞋、皮靴。
    飛鏢課可：卡其褲、西裝褲、皮鞋、皮靴。
2. 上課未依規定使用手機，經勸不聽者，視同缺席。
3. 出缺席：
 (1) 每週上課都會點名或簽到，上課時應盡力參與課堂活動。若身體不適，應主動告知老師。
 (2) 遲到：超過10分鐘才到即計遲到，遲到30分鐘以上該週計缺席。
 (3) 缺席：
    (3.1) 請假：缺席時以學校系統請假，並依學校規定時程處理。
                       事病假證明只需親自手寫原因並拍照上傳。
                       喪假不扣分，需附證明，並在請假後另通知老師避免被列為事假。
    (3.2) 曠課：缺席但未完成請假計為曠課，每次扣1/3平時成績。
    (3.3) 總缺席6次、曠課3次，本學期平時成績0分，學期成績不通過。
 (4) 早退：務必先告知老師再離開。
                 簽到或點名後，未告知老師而早退者，或找他人代簽到/點名者，經第二次點名確認後，視同欺騙行為，本學期平時成績0分且學期成績不通過。
4. 常上iLearn並隨時注意iLearn公告，上課資料也會放在ilearn，並注意學校email的通知信。
policy.course_pol_en:
This course strongly emphasizes “sportsmanship”: Pursuit of excellence, fair competition, follow rules, honesty, respect, responsibility, teamwork, and perseverance.

1. Proper sportswear and sports shoes are required. Non-compliant attire will be treated as an absence and result in a point deduction. 
    Prohibited: Jeans, cargo pants, dress pants, chino pants, sandals, dress shoes, and boots.
    Allowed in the darts class: Chino pants and dress pants (trousers), dress shoes, and boots

2. Using a mobile phone in class without permission, and ignoring warnings, will be considered an absence.

3. Attendance & absence:
  (1) Attendance will be taken or signed in every week. Participate in class activities to the best of your ability. If you feel unwell, inform the instructor.
  (2) Late: Arriving more than 10 minutes late. More than 30 minutes late counts as absent for that week.
  (3) Absence:
       (3.1) Leave of Absences: must be reported through the school system and follow official procedures. In this course, personal and sick leave only requires a handwritten with a photo upload. Bereavement leave does not incur deductions but requires proof and notifying the instructor to avoid being marked as personal leave
       (3.2) SKIP (unexcused absence): Absences without a leave request. Each skip will result in a deduction of 1/3 of the regular performance score (-13 pt).
       (3.3) “Six total absences,” or “three unexcused absences.” Semester attendance score: 0. Semester grade: Fail.
  (4) Leaving early: You must inform the instructor before leaving. If a student signs in or answers roll call but leaves early without informing the Teacher, or have someone else sign in/answer roll for him/her, and this is confirmed during a second roll call, it will be considered as cheating. As a result, the student’s attendances score for the semester will be calculated as 0. Semester grade: Fail.

4. Check iLearn regularly and pay attention to announcements. Class materials will also be posted on iLearn. Please also check your school email for notifications.
policy.course_rem:
1. 第5週適逢運動會週，請配合協助運動會場地整理與佈置
2. 轉適應體育班：加退選期間持「醫院證明」至體育教學中心辦理。 
3. 對運動和學習展現熱忱，積極參與活動，有助輕鬆通過！
4. 本課程為全實體上課，未開放線上課程
policy.course_rem_en:
1. Week 5 coincides with FCU Sports Days; please assist with venue setup and organization.
2. To transfer to the Adaptive PE class: bring a “medical certificate” to the PE Office during the add/drop period.
3. Show enthusiasm for sports and learning, and actively participate in activities to help pass the course easily.
4. This course is fully in-person; online classes are not available.
policy.ais_meno:
1. 簽到或點名後，未告知老師而早退者，或找他人代簽到/點名者，經第二次點名確認後，視同欺騙行為，平時成績0分計算。
2. 書面報告、作業若有抄襲情事，本課程不通過，並送校規處理。
3. 考試找他人代考者，本課程不通過，並送校規處理。
policy.ais_meno_en:
1. Students who leave early without notifying the teacher after signing in or being called, or those who have someone else sign in or answer roll call for them, will be considered as committing cheating behavior upon second verification. Their regular performance score will be recorded as zero.
     
  2. Written reports and assignments found to be plagiarized will result in failing the course and will be handled according to school policy.
     
  3. Having someone else take an exam will result in failing the course and will be handled according to school policy.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 拓展運動學習領域，養成終身運動的習慣，進而提高整體生活品質。
courseBankC.describe_en: To expand the field of sports learning, make lifelong exercising a habit, and enhance students’ overall life quality.
courseBankC.core_item: 溝通協調的能力：具備良好的溝通協調技巧，能有效傳達資訊以處理團隊內外事務。
courseBankC.core_eng: Communication and Coordination：Ability to communicate effectively and coordinate tasks within and across teams.
